correctness.rationale: Independent replay from committed rules passes fully: inputs/artifacts/verify.py run in inputs/ gives 12/12 PASS and VERIFY_OK (84+406 labels per game, P-exhaustion, Lemma A/B, scope completeness, path prefixes). Rules decode correctly against Dailly et al. Def 5: 0.07 (u2=7=1+2+4) allows deleting any connected 2-set; 0.007 (u3=7) allows deleting any connected 3-set, i.e. a P3 (center+2 neighbours) in a tree; P iff component-xor is 0 is standard Sprague-Grundy. Enumerations are exhaustive (.07: each edge once; .007: each P3 once via unique degree-2 center). Scope counts verified combinatorially: stars C(9,3)=84, sides C(8,2)=28, bistars 28*29/2=406, and verifier checks exact key-set equality. N-witnesses checked legal+connected with option-xor 0; P-positions checked exhaustively (all options xor!=0). Lemma A bridge {u,v} deletion leaves 4 disjoint paths Pa+Pb+Pa+Pb with xor 0 uniformly; verifier confirms for all 28. Lemma B's 6 P-positions are already certified by exhaustive P-check; mirror+fallback strategy additionally replayed (crossing options xor!=0, mirror disjoint/legal with xor-0 remainder, 4/4/8 fallbacks on (0,6),(3,6),(6,6) found). Path prefixes agree with heap theory (.07=A002187 to n=35, .007=A071426/A395248 to n=15), used only as cross-check. This is machine-checked finite proof, honestly scoped (no general-n claim).

originality.rationale: Substantive gap verified against nearest priors. Sole graph-board precedent arXiv:1612.05772 (TCS 2018) resolves ONLY game 0.33 on subdivided stars/bistars; full-text Def 5 cites 0.07 as Arc Kayles example but states no .07/.007 outcome table, symmetry lemma, or witness on any tree. Heap records are path/heap-only: OEIS A002187 (.07/Dawson to 1000, period 34), OEIS A071426 (.007 offset) / A395248 (.007 to 2^30, unsolved periodicity, max 1689), Flammenkamp octal tables (heap statistics to millions, .007 rare values to 5029983). Tree moves generate non-path components with different option sets, so heap Grundy values do not transfer and cannot be transcribed. Live arXiv searches confirm: 'octal game' graph returns only 1612.05772 and Grim (1507.05673); 'Arc Kayles subdivided stars', 'Dawson Kayles graph trees', 'Treblecross graph' return zero hits. Arc-Kayles/Node-Kayles complexity literature (PSPACE, WAK) gives no star/bistar P/N census. Different games (0.33 vs .07/.007) with different move sets; no renaming or parameter substitution.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is independently retrievable: first complete normal-play P/N classification with winning-move witnesses for two named games (Dawson .07, Treblecross .007) lifted to graphs, over all 84 subdivided 3-stars S(a,b,c) and 406 single-edge bistars B((a,b),(c,d)) with arms<=6 (.07: stars P=19/N=65, bistars P=69/N=337; .007: stars P=11/N=73, bistars P=40/N=366), plus Lemma A (28/28 symmetric .07 bistars N via bridge) and Lemma B (6 symmetric .007 P-positions with mirror+logged-fallback strategy). Object was motivated before computation (Dailly et al. octal-on-graphs program; paths reproduce heaps; stars/bistars are canonical next families; paper solves only 0.33 leaving .07/.007 open). Values were not known or mechanically implied. A future researcher needs the precise P/N fact, witness move, and symmetric-family strategy as citable base camp for tristars/other octals. Finite-block form does not defeat value: exact invariant of natural object needs no general theorem per standard. Not textbook, not heap repackaging, not tiny unmotivated gain.

decisive_checks: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: PASS star/bistar scope complete (84/406 per game), PASS all 84 star + 406 bistar labels+witnesses per game with stated P/N counts, PASS Lemma A (28/28), PASS Lemma B (6 P + 22 N), PASS path .07==A002187 to 35 and .007==A071426 to 15 -> VERIFY_OK.

Decoded octal digits: .07 u2=7 and .007 u3=7 both allow whole-component removal, connected remainder, and disconnection, hence any connected 2-/3-set deletion; .007 center+2-neighbours enumeration is bijective on trees (unique P3 middle).
Scope arithmetic: stars C(7+3-1,3)=84, sides C(8,2)=28, bistars 28*29/2=406; verifier asserts exact set equality, not just counts.
Lemma A uniformity: bridge {u,v} deletion is legal .07 edge move; remainder Pa+Pb+Pa+Pb has xor 0 for any Grundy values by pairing.
Heap non-transfer: tree option components include stars/2-centre pieces, not just paths, so heap tables cannot imply tree P/N; path agreement is cross-check only.
residual_risks: Verifier and solver share the same Def-5 graph-lift interpretation; mitigated by manual octal-digit decode and path-prefix agreement, but a misreading of Dailly et al. would affect both.
Web originality search limited to arXiv/OEIS/Flammenkamp; unpublished or non-indexed tree-board tables remain possible but no positive evidence found.
Finite block arms<=6 only; no periodicity or general-n theorem is claimed or implied.
Grundy numbers beyond P/N (stored in tables) are replayed but only P/N+witnesses form the headline claim.
